facts.fact: The four arrêtés of 9 July 2026, published 16 July 2026, cite as a legal basis the loi n° 37-2019 of 12 December 2019 relative aux transactions électroniques, treating it as an existing law of the Republic of the Congo; the document does not describe its content.
facts.system: Loi n° 37-2019 relative aux transactions électroniques

facts.fact: The arrêtés cite among their legal basis the décret n° 2025-514 of 29 December 2025 fixing the characteristics of the device for creating and verifying electronic signatures; the document does not say under which law it was made.
facts.system: Décret n° 2025-514 fixant les caractéristiques du dispositif de création et de vérification de la signature électronique

systems.platform: PGSFEC platform; certificates issued by the SFEC certification authority
systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts et des domaines (DGID), with ANSSI and ACONOQ
systems.tiers: taxpayers issuing invoices; terminal and software suppliers and distributors
